svg.title: Forgetting run III: the bone bridge
svg.desc: Sketch set for the third forgetting run, the escort: a bridge of wyrm vertebrae and ribs across the chasm in graphite, gaps in it shown as dashed outline, Remnant archers small and faceless on a ledge above, and halfway over, a cloaked figure drawn only in outline: Ilvarra, when the curse has taken why she is running.
